findings.evidenceJa: それが説明されずじまいだ
findings.governingReading: They never gave us a real explanation
findings.explanation: Issei means the real incident was left unexplained behind a harmless official story; the English treats the matter itself as simply unresolved.

findings.evidenceJa: 昨日の午後から朝まで
findings.governingReading: from yesterday afternoon until this morning
findings.explanation: The investigation’s stated span is narrowed to nighttime.

findings.evidenceJa: 昼休みから珍しくサボリ
findings.governingReading: you unusually cut out from lunchtime
findings.explanation: A rare absence beginning at lunch becomes the broader claim that Shirou skipped school.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ぜんざいぜんざい char=4]善哉善哉
findings.governingReading: sips his tea with a “splendid, splendid”
findings.explanation: Issei’s monkish written-and-spoken assent and comic diction disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: じろり、と一成に向き直る
findings.governingReading: turn and fix Issei with a hard look
findings.explanation: The ominous glare that sets up Issei’s alarm is omitted.

findings.highlight: a new way to question me!? No, do I have to do this now!?
findings.evidenceJa: 新手の押し問答か！？　そもさんなのか！？
findings.governingReading: some new kind of forced debate!? Is this a “sōmon” challenge!?
findings.explanation: Issei’s escalating Zen-debate wordplay is replaced by an unrelated timing question.
A comic attempt to seize and undress Issei is generalized into an attack.

findings.highlight: Issei, the one at the Ryuudou Temple
findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺に関係のある一成
findings.governingReading: Issei, who has ties to Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: Issei’s evidentiary relationship to the temple becomes a vague locative description.
